notes: Official API model ID kimi-k2.6. It has a 262,144-token context window, thinking enabled by default but toggleable off, and a default maximum output setting of 32,768 tokens. Automatic prefix caching requires the preceding request prompt to exceed 256 tokens. The official docs do not publish a separate reasoning-token rate; unknown values are not represented as zero. Published-rate reconciliation, not a provider price increase: the official Batch pricing table directly lists kimi-k2.6 cached input at USD $0.10 per 1M tokens. The same page states Batch inference costs are 60% of standard pricing; Standard cached input is USD $0.16 per 1M tokens, so the derived value is 0.16 x 0.60 = 0.096. The Dataset published price uses the explicit table value 0.10 instead of that derivation. BILLING PRECISION UNCONFIRMED: whether actual invoices retain three decimal places has not been verified. No internal rounding algorithm or invoice-verified settlement rate is asserted. Prices exclude applicable taxes. The observation time is not a new provider effective date. Kimi announced that starting 2026-10-31 K2 series models will no longer be available to newly registered users (existing users are not affected) and plans to retire all K2 series models by the end of December 2026; no exact retirement date has been published. Kimi links migration to kimi-k3.1-pro. Since 2026-10-31 this model is available only to existing Kimi platform users; newly registered accounts cannot use it. As of 2026-10-31, the official model table still lists this ID.

price_records.billing_note: Standard Kimi API pricing. Cache-miss input maps to input and automatic prefix-cache hits map to cached input. Thinking is enabled by default but can be disabled; no separate reasoning surcharge is published.
